name: TyreHotelStorageManager
tagline: Run your tyre hotel like a business: rack, swaps, tread and storage fees in one app.
description: A complete seasonal tyre storage (tyre hotel) app for dealer service departments: rack map with slot check-in, four tread depths per set with replace/advise and uneven-wear alerts, a winter/summer swap planner with daily workshop capacity and a 'to book' campaign queue, fee tracking with release rules, and store-the-removed-set at every swap. Works instantly with sample data in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Rack map per zone (bays × levels) coloured by condition, status, fee or season
Check-in into a free slot with four tread depths and DOT year
Replace / advise / uneven wear / tyre age rules with configurable thresholds
Seasonal swap queue and 14-day planner with capacity per day and overbooking warnings
Fee block on release with override reason; record payment per season
Store the removed set in the freed slot in the same step as the swap
Search, filters, grouping, bulk staging and payments, CSV export, undo
Phone bottom bar, zone switcher and card layouts
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
